reviewDescription: As someone who’s tried cheap foam plugs before, these feel noticeably softer — they compress easily, slide in without that painful jabbing, and actually stay put overnight whether I’m on my back or side. They do a good job dulling snoring, street noise, and general room sounds; nothing magical, but definitely better sleep than bare ears. A couple of things to know realistically: the noise reduction isn’t going to make you totally silent if your partner is snoring like a chainsaw, but it’s pleasantly quieter. After a few nights they compress a bit, which is normal for foam earplugs, so I keep extras handy. For the price, having a big pack of 60 pairs means I don’t stress about using a new pair each night or losing one in the sheets. Comfortable enough that I forget they’re there after a few minutes — which, honestly, is the whole point.
